Emily, did you hear that a new pharmacy is opening on West Avenue?
No, but that's great news.
I usually go to Paxton's Drugstore on Main Street.
It has a very friendly staff, but the parking downtown is so inconvenient.
There's never anywhere to park there.
I agree.
Plus, the article I read about the pharmacy on West Avenue said it's supposed to have wellness classes every week.
It'll be great to learn more about them.
